query: Which stratification factors and blocking schemes most improve balance and power in multi-site obesity trials with diverse demographics?

response.query: Which stratification factors and blocking schemes most improve balance and power in multi-site obesity trials with diverse demographics?
response.answer: Stratification by age, sex, and baseline BMI, along with blocking by site, most improve balance and power in multi-site obesity trials. These factors account for demographic diversity and local variations.

results.title: Rising Obesity in an Aging America
results.content: Obesity rates have risen dramatically in recent years, nearly doubling among older U.S. adults to include two in every five Americans ages 65 and older.
